name: recruiting-ovarian-trial-language-v1
normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, alpha character α to 'alpha', Unicode dash punctuation and ASCII '-' to spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace; Unicode word-boundary literal phrase matching, independently within each field/list item; no stemming, negation removal or semantic inference.
phase_rule: One study in its canonical combined-phase category; NA distinct from absent/null/empty; reject unknown/duplicate values or NA mixed with real phases.
interpretation: Public registry language mentions only, including negations, exclusion criteria and background. Query-matched basket studies retained. No eligibility inference, treatment ranking, outcome analysis or novelty claim.
retention: Projected protocol fields held in process memory only. Persist aggregate counts, exact requests, whole-response hashes and provenance; no study rows, NCT ID lists, text snippets or eligibility narratives.
completion_rule: Stable totalCount across all pages; unique NCT IDs in ascending order; no repeated nextPageToken; terminal record count equals totalCount; identical apiVersion/dataTimestamp before and after. These are drift checks, not an atomic-snapshot guarantee.
